text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the sitters for their dedication and reliability during walks and home visits. Clients note that team members like Monika and Maggie arrive with genuine enthusiasm for the animals. Reviewers highlight that sitters take time to learn individual pet routines and make owners feel completely at ease while away.

Multiple reviewers emphasize how gently the team handles nervous or anxious dogs and cats. Owners appreciate that sitters accommodate special pet routines and provide comforting attention during drop-in visits. Clients report that even naturally timid pets quickly warm up to the staff and stay relaxed throughout their scheduled visits.

Most pet parents praise the detailed notes and fun photos sent promptly after each dog walk or cat visit. However, one reviewer reported dissatisfaction regarding communication and staffing availability for an apartment community event. Clients who use private walking and sitting services describe coordination as smooth and responsive.

q.en: Do sitters send updates after visits?

a.en: Yes, clients regularly receive detailed notes and photos of their pets after each walk or sitting session.

q.en: Can the team accommodate anxious or shy animals?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that sitters patiently learn each pet's habits and make anxious dogs and cats feel comfortable.

q.en: Are dog walks tracked with GPS?

a.en: Yes, the company provides GPS-tracked visits along with photo reports according to its service policies.
